THE SCRIPT

Write the whole episode.

One line per spoken line. Tags in brackets set the feeling, action and camera. A >> SCREEN line changes the monitor on the next line.

FormatREN [worried, facepalm]: Line here.MICA [idea, raise, pause=0.8]: Line.>> SCREEN alert: KICKER | Title | Subtitle>> SCREEN info +progress: … | … | …FeelingsActionsCameras

Paste the prompt into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini (free plans work), then paste the script it writes back here.
